81:export const getLogic = ({
82:  bar,
83:  rotationSystem,
84:  wellDepth,
85:  wellWidth
86:}: GameProps) => {
87:  /**
88:    Generate a unique integer to describe the position and orientation of this piece.
89:    `x` varies between -3 and (`wellWidth` - 1) inclusive, so range = `wellWidth` + 3
90:    `y` varies between 0 and (`wellDepth` + 2) inclusive, so range = `wellDepth` + 3
91:    `o` varies between 0 and 3 inclusive, so range = 4
92:  */
93:  const getHashCode = (piece: Piece): number =>
94:    (piece.x * (wellDepth + 3) + piece.y) * 4 + piece.o
95:
96:  /**
97:    Input {wellState, piece} and a move, return
98:    the new {wellState, piece}.
99:  */
100:  const getNextState = (wellState: WellState, move: string): WellState => {
101:    let nextWell = wellState.core.well
102:    let nextScore = wellState.core.score
103:    const nextAiState = wellState.ai
104:    const piece = wellState.piece
105:
106:    /* node:coverage disable */
107:    if (piece === null) {
108:      throw Error('Can\'t get next well state if there is no piece in the well')
109:    }
110:    /* node:coverage enable */
111:
112:    let nextPiece: Piece | null = { ...piece }
113:
114:    // apply transform
115:    if (move === 'L') {
116:      nextPiece.x--
117:    }
118:    if (move === 'R') {
119:      nextPiece.x++
120:    }
121:    if (move === 'D') {
122:      nextPiece.y++
123:    }
124:    if (move === 'U') {
125:      nextPiece.o = (nextPiece.o + 1) % 4
126:    }
127:
128:    const orientation = rotationSystem.rotations[nextPiece.id][nextPiece.o]
129:    const xActual = nextPiece.x + orientation.xMin
130:    const yActual = nextPiece.y + orientation.yMin
131:
132:    if (
133:      xActual < 0 || // off left side
134:      xActual + orientation.xDim > wellWidth || // off right side
135:      yActual < 0 || // off top (??)
136:      yActual + orientation.yDim > wellDepth || // off bottom
137:      orientation.rows.some((row, y) =>
138:        wellState.core.well[yActual + y] & (row << xActual)
139:      ) // obstruction
140:    ) {
141:      if (move === 'D') {
142:        // Lock piece
143:        nextWell = wellState.core.well.slice()
144:
145:        const orientation = rotationSystem.rotations[piece.id][piece.o]
146:
147:        // this is the top left point in the bounding box of this orientation of this piece
148:        const xActual = piece.x + orientation.xMin
149:        const yActual = piece.y + orientation.yMin
150:
151:        // row by row bitwise line alteration
152:        for (let row = 0; row < orientation.yDim; row++) {
153:          // can't negative bit-shift, but alas X can be negative
154:          nextWell[yActual + row] |= (orientation.rows[row] << xActual)
155:        }
156:
157:        // check for complete lines now
158:        // NOTE: completed lines don't count if you've lost
159:        for (let row = 0; row < orientation.yDim; row++) {
160:          if (
161:            yActual >= bar &&
162:            nextWell[yActual + row] === (1 << wellWidth) - 1
163:          ) {
164:            // move all lines above this point down
165:            for (let k = yActual + row; k > 1; k--) {
166:              nextWell[k] = nextWell[k - 1]
167:            }
168:
169:            // insert a new blank line at the top
170:            // though of course the top line will always be blank anyway
171:            nextWell[0] = 0
172:
173:            nextScore++
174:          }
175:        }
176:        nextPiece = null
177:      } else {
178:        // No move
179:        nextPiece = piece
180:      }
181:    }
182:
183:    return {
184:      core: {
185:        well: nextWell,
186:        score: nextScore
187:      },
188:      ai: nextAiState,
189:      piece: nextPiece
190:    }
191:  }

89:    `x` varies between -3 and (`wellWidth` - 1) inclusive, so range = `wellWidth` + 3
90:    `y` varies between 0 and (`wellDepth` + 2) inclusive, so range = `wellDepth` + 3
91:    `o` varies between 0 and 3 inclusive, so range = 4
92:  */
93:  const getHashCode = (piece: Piece): number =>
94:    (piece.x * (wellDepth + 3) + piece.y) * 4 + piece.o
95:
96:  /**
97:    Input {wellState, piece} and a move, return
98:    the new {wellState, piece}.
99:  */

101:    let nextWell = wellState.core.well
102:    let nextScore = wellState.core.score
103:    const nextAiState = wellState.ai
104:    const piece = wellState.piece
105:
106:    /* node:coverage disable */
107:    if (piece === null) {
108:      throw Error('Can\'t get next well state if there is no piece in the well')
109:    }
110:    /* node:coverage enable */
111:
112:    let nextPiece: Piece | null = { ...piece }
113:
114:    // apply transform
115:    if (move === 'L') {
116:      nextPiece.x--
117:    }
118:    if (move === 'R') {
119:      nextPiece.x++
120:    }
121:    if (move === 'D') {
122:      nextPiece.y++
123:    }
124:    if (move === 'U') {
125:      nextPiece.o = (nextPiece.o + 1) % 4
126:    }

128:    const orientation = rotationSystem.rotations[nextPiece.id][nextPiece.o]

130:    const yActual = nextPiece.y + orientation.yMin

132:    if (

135:      yActual < 0 || // off top (??)

155:        }
156:
157:        // check for complete lines now

180:      }
181:    }

193:  /**

202:    // move the piece down to a lower position before we have to

329:    }

331:    const nextWellState = nextWellStates[nextWellStateId]
332:
333:    // Is the game over?

336:    const gameIsOver = nextWellState.core.well[bar - 1] !== 0
337:
338:    const nextMode = gameIsOver ? 'GAME_OVER' : mode
